result.summary: The page appears mostly functional and well-structured. One notable visual issue was identified related to text truncation in the restaurant listing cards.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis, making it appear broken rather than intentionally clipped. The text is cut mid-word ('Piccol' instead of 'Piccolo' or full name), which looks like a rendering issue rather than a deliberate design choice.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a fixed width to restaurant name labels in carousel cards so truncation appears intentional and clean.
